answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 149913 Country: India Title: Islamic names Question: Please Suggest best names from this list or if you have better name suggestion please mention it. We will be highly appreciate your suggestions. JazakAllah khair - May Almighty Allah bless you all for your kindest helps and give you best of best reward. Boy: (1) Mohammed Abdul Mohsin (2) Mohammed Abdul Muqeet (3) Mohammed Abdul Moghni (4) Mohammed Abdul Bari. Girl: (1) Safwah Abdul Hannan (2) Nida Abdul Hannan (3) Rida Abdul Hannan (4) Aleena Abdul Hannan (5) Hiba Abdul Hannan. Please provide the exact meaning of these names according to Islam. Answer ID: 149913 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 651/531/D=7/1438) Mohsin: means benefactor. It is not among the beautiful names of Allah, hence you should not keep the name Abdul Mohsin rather keep Muhammad Mohsin only. Al-Muqeet: The Nourisher. It is of the attributes of Allah hence it is correct to name as Abdul Muqeet. Al-Mughni: The Enricher, the Emancipator. It is also one of the attributes of Allah hence it is also right to name as Abdul Mughni. Al-Bari: The Maker. It is also correct to name as Abdul Bari. Safwah: means distinct, chosen and selected. The child selected by Abdul Hannan. Nadia means corner. Ilaina: we could not get its meaning. Rida means chuddar. Hibah means gift. You may add Safwah with Abdul Hannan but if you add it with other names then it shall not bring any goodness or meaning. Hence you should choose any name among the names of the holy wives and the Sahabiyat. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
